# United States Department of Justice

> > Official website of the U.S. Department of Justice, led by Attorney General Pamela Bondi, overseeing federal law enforcement, criminal prosecution, civil rights protection, and immigration adjudication.

The Department of Justice (DOJ) is the federal executive department responsible for enforcing the law and defending the interests of the United States. The site provides access to DOJ leadership, organizational components including the FBI, DEA, ATF, Criminal Division, Executive Office for Immigration Review, and resources for crime reporting, legal forms, and case information.

## Key Topics

- Department of Justice (DOJ)
- Attorney General Pamela Bondi
- Criminal Division
- Law Enforcement
- Federal Prosecution
- Civil Rights Protection
- Immigration Court & Adjudication
- Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR)
- Crime Reporting
- FBI, DEA, ATF (DOJ Agencies)
- Board of Immigration Appeals
- Press Releases & Public Affairs
- Legal Resources & Publications
- Organizational Structure
- Mission & Values

## Core Information

- [Department of Justice Homepage](https://www.justice.gov/): DOJ homepage with mission, leadership, and crime reporting resources
- [About DOJ](https://www.justice.gov/about): About DOJ: mission, organizational structure, and agency overview
- [Office of the Attorney General](https://www.justice.gov/ag): Attorney General Pamela Bondi's office: leadership and legal matters
- [Our Work](https://www.justice.gov/our-work): DOJ priorities, initiatives, and law enforcement programs overview

## Divisions & Agencies

- [Criminal Division](https://www.justice.gov/criminal): Criminal Division: federal prosecution, enforcement policy, and cases
- [DOJ Agencies & Organizational Chart](https://www.justice.gov/agencies/chart): DOJ organizational chart showing FBI, DEA, ATF, and other agencies

## Immigration Services

- [Immigration Court Online Resource (ICOR)](https://icor.eoir.justice.gov/): Immigration Court online resource for case status and legal info
- [Automated Case Information System (ACIS)](https://acis.eoir.justice.gov/en/): ACIS: Immigration case lookup and tracking system

## Resources & Tools

- [Legal Resources & Publications](https://www.justice.gov/resources): Legal resources, forms, publications, and crime reporting tools
